purpose: Concrete inputs needed to move beyond the verified offline engineering work. Fill answers in a private copy; do not commit personal contacts, account details, contracts, raw samples or human labels.

boundaries.empty_packets: Deliberately fail readiness checks. Ready for review is not ready to run.

clock_authority_question_draft.recipient: [Official SEC support/contact selected and approved by the user]
clock_authority_question_draft.subject: Historical acceptance timestamp field definitions for 2022-2024
clock_authority_question_draft.message: For independent personal research, could you identify authoritative published definitions and effective versions for the 14-digit SGML ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME, the filing-index Accepted display, submissions-API acceptanceDateTime and corresponding bulk representation for 2022-2024? In particular: timezone/DST semantics, whether any historical Z-labelled values represent unconverted local wall time, applicable corrections/errata, and whether reported acceptance is the relevant dissemination/availability event. We found Eastern operating-hour/filing-date rules, but those do not answer the field-specific question. Please distinguish intended format/clock from accuracy guarantees and provide a citable versioned source; may any response be cited in public research?
context_to_attach_if_approved: Official May2025 PDS technical-specification version and December2021 EFM VolumeIIv60 citations from project_closure_review.json.
Only a separately approved public metadata example if needed; no private panel, payload, identities, credentials or benchmark text.
clock_authority_question_draft.not_done: No support request sent and no field-clock certification inferred.

data_rights_question_draft.candidate: Sharadar full-history prices/actions as a qualification candidate, conditional on exact channel and rights; legitimate CRSP entitlement is the complete-return alternative.
data_rights_question_draft.recipient: [Vendor licensing/contact selected and approved by the user]
data_rights_question_draft.subject: Personal research qualification, evaluation-publication and independent-review permissions
data_rights_question_draft.message: Before acquiring data, please confirm the exact product/channel/full-history entitlement and whether this independent personal research qualifies under the personal/non-professional terms. Can we publish code, nonreconstructive statistics and a data-qualification evaluation, including failure counts? What specific written approval is needed under section8? What input/identifier access may independent reviewers have, what outputs may survive termination, and what must be deleted, including backups/normalized caches? Please distinguish direct-site terms from any Nasdaq Data Link entitlement and provide the governing dated terms.
capability_questions: Permanent share-class/security IDs, dated ticker/venue/SIC and dated issuer/CIK links.
Cash plus stock versus election alternatives, fractional shares, warrants, OTC paths, bankrupt reorganizations, cancellations and terminal payoffs.
Known CVR exclusion and what a narrower qualification can honestly cover.
As-reported fundamentals dimensions, filing-date indexing versus actual availability, restatements and correction/known-at vintages.
Approved bounded pre-2024-07-31 sample for the fixed12-case panel, including the unresolved legal-authority records.
user_supplies: Chosen provider/product/channel and legitimate entitlement or proposed spending cap.
Explicit permission before account creation, keys, purchases or vendor contact.
Actual dated licensing/permission receipts in the private source packet; code does not interpret or authenticate them.
data_rights_question_draft.not_done: No source selected, licence accepted, price acquired, payment or contact.

human_annotation_handoff.needed: Two independent human annotators and a third adjudicator when decisions or unitization differ.
user_supplies: Approved frozen roster with dated issuer/industry and annual/year-earlier-quarter eligibility.
Company-disjoint chronological calibration/development/audit bounds and source hashes.
Full target sections or a declared block-scoped pilot; a block pass cannot establish whole-filing recall.
instructions: Give each annotator a separate private first-pass file; hide other labels, model suggestions, returns, later news/filings and registered ranks.
Retain exact evidence, entity/period/unit/scope/modality and completeness. Missing is unknown, not zero change.
Preserve independent files and guide versions; no model consensus or matching CSVs automatically becomes verified gold.
Review intake discrepancies and segmentation disagreements before adjudication; later scoring uses the existing measurement contract only with actual verified/complete gold.
human_annotation_handoff.budget_status: Draft guide estimates are not approved hours. Time calibration examples before committing a full audit.
human_annotation_handoff.not_done: No people recruited, actual60-pair roster chosen, labels or AI pre-labels created.

user_supplies: Minimum economically meaningful incremental net effect beyond the matched cosine baseline.
A separately approved qualified historical observation window and enough genuinely independent periods.
A prospectively specified size-calibrated method at the actual factor/overlap/dependence geometry, including the relevant tail.
A decision about whether the original formalH1 test remains not testable or a versioned new design is proposed; never silently replace it.
inference_design_inputs.current_limit: No tested monthly method passes T17/18/28. Optimistic MDE arithmetic is not a calibrated project MDE. Opening holdout, training a reader or finding more filings does not create independent months.
inference_design_inputs.not_done: No new simulations, parameter sweep, economic margin guessed, return evaluation or holdout opening.

needed: Qualified dated tradability, auction/early-close feasibility, fees/spread/impact and borrow, or a separately specified long-only design.
Explicit one-way/gross turnover and distribution-in-gross basis; use existing costs reconciliation rather than double count.
Approved source snapshots and a worker where network, credentials and sealed files are actually unavailable, with negative tests and hard resource controls.
Personal/public sources only; no employer's code, data, credentials or borrowed entitlement.
Preserve hashes, failures, exclusions and F7/F8 reconciliation history before any new result.
execution_and_isolation_inputs.not_done: No Docker/host ACL/container provisioning, price/return data, source repair or financial rerun.
